facts.fact: Togo-Presse reports that in 2024 the CFE and the RCCM were connected with other administrative platforms and that a citizen can create a company account online through the Services publics portal.
Togo-Presse reports that a database of companies' beneficial owners has been created, to identify who really holds a company.
Togo-Presse reports that, through an online portal, citizens can now carry out all Cadastre procedures for a land title remotely, and that a unique parcel number (NUP) has been introduced.

TGO.note: The document names no police station records; its security services are portal procedures for the public.
